title: PlayKiln capability manifest
description: Machine-readable description of what a capability artifact brings into a slot: SDKs, permissions, collected data and its test double. scripts/capability-registry.mjs and scripts/store-kit.py read these files to generate the Play Data safety answers, so they must stay truthful.

id.description: Must equal the Gradle module name.

summary.description: One sentence a human reads in the capability registry.

since.description: Capability version this module first shipped in.

optionalForSlots.description: false means every slot must include it (e.g. a safety or compliance baseline).

sdkDependencies.description: Third-party/Google SDKs bundled by this artifact. Reported in Play Data safety as third-party SDKs.

permissions.description: Manifest permissions the artifact declares. Anything dangerous needs a justification here or verify-slot fails.

dataCollected.description: Play Data safety data types. Empty means the capability collects nothing.

optional.description: true when the user can use the app without providing it.

requiresConsent.description: true when the capability must not do network work before the user resolves a consent dialog (EEA/UK obligations).

adsPresent.description: true forces the store pack to declare ads in the listing and Data safety.

testDoubles.description: Deterministic implementations slots must use in unit tests. Mandatory for networked capabilities.

publicApi.description: Entry points a slot is expected to use; everything else is internal.

policyNotes.description: Non-obvious Play policy obligations this capability creates.
